edges.reason: enableDisableDevFee authorizes the caller solely by comparing msg.sender to the liquidityWallet state variable.
msg.sender is used for blacklist checks inside the transfer override.
User address for dividend withdrawal is derived from msg.sender.
claim forwards msg.sender to the tracker processAccount call.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline, making execution timestamp dependent.

Claim eligibility compares block.timestamp against lastClaimTime and claimWait.
lastClaimTimes is written from block.timestamp.
secondsUntilAutoClaimAvailable is computed from block.timestamp.
tx.origin is emitted as the processor in ProcessedDividendTracker.
tx.origin is referenced in the anti-bot hook region of the transfer override.
swapAndSendToDev executes a raw ETH transfer of the full swapped balance to a hardcoded address.
_withdrawDividendOfUser performs an external ERC20 transfer to the user after crediting withdrawnDividends.
swapTokensForEth invokes the Uniswap router swapExactTokensForETH call.
swapTokensForDividendToken invokes the Uniswap router token swap call.
swapAndSendDividends performs an external transfer of dividend tokens to the tracker.
The transfer override makes an external setBalance call into the tracker from within transfer execution.
The transfer override makes an external process call into the tracker that can pay out dividends.
swapAndSendDividends calls the amount-based distributeDividends on the tracker.
setDividendTokenAddress is public and overwrites the dividendToken state variable without ownership checks.
The dividendToken address determines the ERC20 contract used for the dividend payout transfer.
processAccount calls _withdrawDividendOfUser to pay dividends to the account.
claim invokes processAccount on the tracker for the caller.
process iterates holders and calls processAccount for auto-claimable accounts.
The transfer override triggers swapAndSendToDev during liquidation.
The transfer override triggers swapAndSendDividends during liquidation.
swapAndSendToDev calls swapTokensForEth before forwarding ETH.
swapAndSendDividends calls swapTokensForDividendToken before distributing.

normalization_plan.reason: The newToken parameter only exists to assign the dividendToken state variable inside setDividendTokenAddress.
The _devFeeEnabled parameter only controls the _swapEnabled assignment inside enableDisableDevFee.
The tokenAmount parameter is consumed directly by the router swap in swapTokensForEth.
The tokens parameter is only used to seed the ETH swap inside swapAndSendToDev.
The recipient parameter is only forwarded to the router swap call.
The account parameter identifies the dividend receiver inside processAccount.
The gas parameter bounds the holder iteration loop inside process.
The newBalance parameter drives the mint/burn synchronization inside setBalance.
The _withdrawableDividend local is computed and transferred inside _withdrawDividendOfUser.
The newBalance local is the swapped ETH delta forwarded to the dev address in swapAndSendToDev.
